exposure: Conception timeframe (<18 months vs. ≥18 months postoperative)
cohort: 135 US adult women who underwent RYGB or SG and subsequently reported ≥ 1 pregnancy within 7 years
finding: While 40% of neonates born to women who conceived within 7 years after RYGB or SG experienced a composite adverse outcome (stillbirth, preterm birth, small for gestational age, or NICU admission), there was no statistically significant difference in the prevalence of maternal or neonatal outcomes based on the time from surgery to conception.
